subject: Post-call MAP: Integration build commitments & owners (SDK / streaming / tool-calls)
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Elliot Ross <elliot.ross@medvera.com>, Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@medvera.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@medvera.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call MAP: Integration build commitments & owners (SDK / streaming / tool-calls)

Thanks again for the call today — appreciate the clarity on Medvera's timeline and the internal stakeholders. Per our agreement, attaching the draft MAP and an integration checklist for the SDK/streaming/tool-calling milestone. High-level recap + ask below.

Recap (call notes)
- Business driver: fast, low-latency clinical suggestion feature in the Medvera EHR workflow.
- Target production pilot: targeted by end of Q2 (target close / go-live planning: 2027-06-30).
- Key dependencies: SAML SSO onboarding, HIPAA DPA + security sign-off, and access to a representative test dataset (de‑identified).

Proposed MAP milestone: "Integration build" (SDK + streaming + tool-calls + structured outputs)
- Deliverables: SDK integration (Java + Python), streaming call support, tool-calling hooks, JSON structured output schema for clinical suggestions.
- Ownership (proposed): Ben Carter (Redwood) — SDK & streaming; Monica Patel (Redwood) — test orchestration & CI; Raj Patel (Medvera) — backend integration & deployment; Samantha Ortiz (Medvera) — PM / acceptance criteria.
- Target milestone date: 2027-05-31 for dev cutover; 2027-06-30 for pilot readiness.
- Blockers: security questionnaire/responses, signed DPA, test dataset delivery, and test service account/keys.

Next steps / asks (please reply inline):
1) Medvera to confirm owners and whether any other internal reviewers should be added to the MAP.
2) Medvera to confirm timeline for DPA and whether procurement needs a separate doc.
3) Medvera to provide a de-identified test dataset or a data schema sample by 2027-04-28.
4) Ben / engineering: confirm required API surface and any additional integration artifacts we should include in the checklist.

Attachments: MAP_Medvera_v0.3.pdf (draft), SDK_Build_Checklist.xlsx (workback + tasks).

I'll follow up after we get your owner confirmation and the test dataset ETA.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0173

From: Elliot Ross <elliot.ross@medvera.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@medvera.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@medvera.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call MAP: Integration build commitments & owners (SDK / streaming / tool-calls)

Karthik — thanks for the clear recap. We are aligned on the overall milestone and timeline; a couple of clarifications from our side: 

- Owners: confirmed — Samantha (PM) and Raj (Eng) will be primary Medvera contacts. I'll loop in procurement (Karen Li) separately for the DPA.
- Dependencies: SAML SSO is going to be the longest pole. Our infra team estimates 3 weeks for initial SAML test integration once we have the certs.
- Data: we can provide a de-identified sample (CSV schema + 200 rows) by 2027-04-28, but full dataset access will require a DPA signature.
- Test environment: we need a dedicated sandbox endpoint + short-lived test tokens and a clear rotation cadence. Can Redwood provide a test service account?

Procurement note: Karen will ask for a high-level scoping doc for legal review. I'll attach an internal procurement timeline in my next message.

Elliot
Elliot Ross
Head of Product, Medvera Inc.
elliot.ross@medvera.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elliot Ross <elliot.ross@medvera.com>, Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@medvera.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@medvera.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 11:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call MAP: Integration build commitments & owners (SDK / streaming / tool-calls)

Looping in plan + owners and adding a couple of internal milestones: 

Action owners (internal)
- Karthik (AE) — overall MAP coordination, weekly check-ins, stakeholder updates.
- Marissa (CS) — acceptance criteria & pilot success metrics; schedule 2 QA regression windows.
- Ben (Eng Lead) — SDK implementation, streaming pipeline, tool-call adapters (Java/Python).
- Monica (SRE) — CI/canary pipeline, test env provisioning, and monitoring hooks.

Internal milestones we will own: 
- 2027-05-07: SDK scaffolding + sample client pushed to test repo (owner: Ben).
- 2027-05-21: Streaming integration POC complete (owner: Ben).
- 2027-05-28: Test environment + service account provisioned (owner: Monica).
- 2027-06-04: End-to-end internal test & smoke (owner: Marissa).

Ben — can you confirm you can deliver the scaffolding by 5/7 and call out any extra support you need from Medvera (sample request/response shapes, auth certs, example logs)?

Marissa — I'll add acceptance criteria to the MAP doc and share a short list for the QA windows.

Thanks — I'll update the MAP draft after Ben confirms.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Customer Success | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elliot Ross <elliot.ross@medvera.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@medvera.com>, Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@medvera.com>
Date: Sat, 24 Apr 2027 10:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call MAP: Integration build commitments & owners (SDK / streaming / tool-calls)

Confirming the internal milestones — I can hit 5/7 for SDK scaffolding. Quick technical notes and asks so Medvera can prepare: 

SDK & streaming notes
- SDKs: we will provide Java and Python clients with examples for synchronous generation and streaming token-by-token hooks.
- Streaming: requires WebSocket endpoint + connection lifecycle (reconnect strategy) — recommend P99 keepalive of 45s.
- Tool calling: we'll expose a lightweight action registry; Medvera should provide an initial list of tool signatures (name, input schema, expected outputs).
- Structured outputs: we'll define a top-level JSON envelope: {"suggestions": [], "metadata": {}} — Medvera to provide expected fields for "suggestions" elements for acceptance tests.

Integration asks for Medvera
- Provide sample request/response examples and one representative log line showing the EHR event that will trigger calls.
- Provide SAML cert for sandbox or confirm alternative SSO approach.
- Create a sandbox service account and issue a test API key (scoped, expires in 30 days).

Testing plan
- Once scaffolding is up, Redwood will run an internal POC and share smoke test logs. Need Medvera to run a single end-to-end test window (2 hours) during the week of 5/21.

Schedule
- I'm available for a 60-minute technical kickoff on Mon 2027-04-26 (10am PT) or Tue 2027-04-27 (1pm PT). Please confirm a time.

Ben
Ben Carter
Engineering Lead, Integrations | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

Thanks everyone — this looks good. We will:
